name: Speed Run 4 Classic
desc:
This is the classic edition of Speed Run 4! Join in the fun and test your skill with this fast paced classic platformer. 

There are 30 unique levels to run through to victory. Race friends, or race against the clock while keeping an eye on the timer - in Speed Run 4 Classic!

scripts.title: Speedrun 4 Cl*ic Gem farm
scripts.features: Farms gems slowly but undetectable and easy
scripts.script:
local apple = game:GetService("Players")
local banana = game:GetService("Teams")
local cherry = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local pear = apple.LocalPlayer

local function grape()
	local mango67 = cherry:WaitForChild("BackToLobby")
	if not mango67:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end

	local function peach()
		if pear.Team == banana:WaitForChild("Winners") then
			mango67:FireServer()
		end
	end

	pear:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(peach)
	peach()
end

local function lemon()
	local kiwi = workspace:GetChildren()[1330]
	if not kiwi or not kiwi:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	task.spawn(function()
		while task.wait(0.001) do
			if pear.Character and pear.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				pear.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = kiwi.CFrame
			end
		end
	end)
end

grape()
lemon()
